messages:
maya: Quick check — onboarding gaudi-7b-qlora weights are at s3://redwood-models/gaudi/gaudi-7b-qlora/v1/weights.tar.gz. Before I kick off dedicated onboarding, who can sanity-check KV cache format + max-context config? I'm worried about OOM on 80G machines. cc @ahmed @sophie

ahmed: I pulled the weights and tokenizer. Path looks good. Tokenizer has a weird multi-utf8 pad behavior — need to set `pad_to_multiple_of=1` in the tokenization config. KV cache format for the converted checkpoints is `kv_v2`. Running local smoke test now.

ahmed: ```bash
# smoke run (local)
ri run --model-path s3://redwood-models/gaudi/gaudi-7b-qlora/v1 \n  --dtype float16 --max-seq 65536 --kv-format kv_v2 \n  --batch 1 --input 'Hello world' --profile
```

sophie: FYI I merged a config validation PR that will help catch bad max-seq settings: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/482 — it rejects `max_seq` > model.max_ctx unless `allow_large_seq=true`. I'll tag runtime for canary rollout. :eyes:

oliver: Heads-up — on a single A100-80, float16 + kv_v2 + batch 2 + seq 65536 uses ~36-40GB just for the KV cache, plus ~40GB for model shards. You probably need either multi-replica or to cap default at 32k. Please run the estimate tool: `ri util estimate-memory --model gaudi-7b-qlora --seq 65536 --batch 1 --dtype float16`.

maya: good call. Ahmed, can you run estimate-memory and paste numbers? I'll hold dedicated onboarding until we confirm fallback to 32k if OOM.

ahmed: ran it — output from `ri util estimate-memory`:
`estimated_total=94GB, kv_cache=42GB, model_params=40GB, overhead=12GB`
So with batch 1 it OOMs on a single A100-80 if everything is colocated. Recommendation: set `autoscale.min_replicas=2` for dedicated or set `default_max_seq=32768` in model config.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: canary runtime image `runtime:2026-03-14` -> eng-ml-canary at 1823456900

sophie: I'll add a model-config change: `max_context: 65536`, `allowed_fallbacks: [32768, 16384]`, `kv_format: kv_v2`. PR incoming with tests + validation.

maya: thanks everyone. Action items: (1) config PR (sophie) (2) estimate memory in CI smoke (ahmed) (3) add canary with autoscale 2 (oliver) (4) doc note about tokenizer pad quirk (maya). I'll update onboarding checklist. :thumbsup:
